purpose: Brand concept review only; these boards are not production icons or app screenshots.
commonPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: polished brand identity concept board for a private period and perimenopause journal mobile app. Create one landscape 1536x1024 presentation board, refined and feminine, adult, soft and clean, with generous whitespace and crisp readable type. Original vector-friendly emblem with a strong silhouette, broad shapes and balanced negative space; absolutely no stock clipart, medical symbols, wombs, literal blood drops, faces, moons, sparkles, gradients, 3D effects, glossy effects or tiny filigree. Design an original brand, not an imitation of an existing app. Layout: large wordmark and tagline at upper left; a prominent rounded-square launcher icon and a smaller circular-mask rendering below it; four simple palette swatches at lower left. At right, two slim front-facing Android phone silhouettes side by side showing light and dark native launch screens. Each phone has ONLY a modest centered emblem on a perfectly solid background: no name, tagline, loading spinner, buttons, artwork or other content inside either screen. Reuse exactly the SAME emblem across the icon, circular icon and both phones, changing colors only. Clear small labels outside the phones read 'Light launch' and 'Dark launch'. The launcher icon contains only the emblem, not text. Below the wordmark show the descriptor 'Private cycle journal'. At the bottom of the board show 'Brand concept / for review'. Do not render app UI or fabricated data. Flat elegant design presentation, tasteful alignment, excellent contrast, no decorative props or extra text. Typography: distinctive legible contemporary serif wordmark, restrained humanist sans-serif for other text.

directions.prompt: Brand name exactly 'Liltara' (L-i-l-t-a-r-a). Tagline exactly 'Your rhythm. Your record.'. Warm plum #604054, petal rose #E4BACB, ivory #FBF7F5, dark plum #261F28. The original emblem is three broad softly curved petal shapes arranged in an open circular embrace, with a clear off-center opening and a generous ivory negative-space center. It should evoke changing rhythms and a flower in a single memorable abstract shape, not a generic five-petal daisy. Flat ivory-and-rose emblem on the solid plum launcher tile. Ivory light launch with plum emblem; dark plum launch with ivory-and-rose emblem. Ivory board background. The wordmark is large dark plum, warm and graceful, with readable broad strokes rather than hairlines. This is the leading direction, with quiet confidence and a gently feminine character.

Brand name exactly 'Alinelle' (A-l-i-n-e-l-l-e). Tagline exactly 'A little space for you.'. Dusty violet #665779, pale lilac #D9CFE7, porcelain #FAF8FC, dark violet #26222E. The original emblem is a softly folded ribbon forming a simple abstract capital A, with curved sides, one generous central opening and one quiet diagonal fold. Elegant, personal and warm; an abstract monogram with no plant or flower. Flat porcelain-and-lilac emblem on solid dusty-violet launcher tile. Porcelain light launch with violet emblem; dark violet launch with porcelain-and-lilac emblem. Porcelain board background. The wordmark is large violet in a legible elegant contemporary serif. A calm, personal-journal identity, visibly different from a floral brand.

Brand name exactly 'Tendrille' (T-e-n-d-r-i-l-l-e). Tagline exactly 'Room for every season.'. Deep botanical teal #365C53, soft sage #C9D8CC, warm cream #FAF8F1, dark forest #1E2C28. The original emblem is a single broad curved stem curling into an open loop with two rounded leaves, balanced and compact. It suggests a tender new shoot, drawn with solid broad shapes, no delicate linework or elaborate sprig. Flat cream-and-sage emblem on a solid deep-teal launcher tile. Cream light launch with deep-teal emblem; dark forest launch with cream-and-sage emblem. Cream board background. The wordmark is large deep teal in a warm rounded contemporary serif. Botanical, feminine and grounded, suited to periods and the changes of perimenopause.
